messages:
elena: Quick sync 1 product approved a gentle sunset for v1. plan: short banner, staged redirects to /docs/v2/compat, and a tiny migrate guide addendum for SDK gotchas. target staging: 2026-04-15.

samir: good. split tasks: banner copy+i18n, redirect rules, SDK auth note + example, ops rollout checklist.

anya: i'll take banners + en/fr/ja. will keep each banner <=110 chars and include CTA to /docs/v2/migrate-v1.

elena: include exact phrase: "Planned deprecation: v1 API. Migrate to v2 by 2026-05-15." keep under 120 chars.

michael: quick tech note: Go clients have inconsistent trimming of Authorization header which can fail if token has stray whitespace. i'll add a docs snippet and a unit test in go-sdk.

michael: suggested snippet for auth section:
```
// Go: normalize Authorization header
req.Header.Set("Authorization", strings.TrimSpace("Bearer "+token))
resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
if err != nil { /* handle */ }
```

samir: add Python example too? just `req.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token.strip()}"` should do.

elena: ops wants a 302 for staging with analytics param so we can measure. proposed nginx rule:
```
location ~ ^/docs/v1/(.*)$ {
  return 302 /docs/v2/compat/$1?deprecated=v1;
}
```

deploy-bot: Task created: OPS-4122  staged-redirect + banner rollout (staging). ETA 2026-04-08. Assigned to elena.

anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5533  banners + i18n.

michael: will open go-sdk PR linking #5533 and add trimming test. aiming for Monday.

samir: checklist to include in docs PR description:
- [ ] banners/i18n merged (#5533)
- [ ] auth note added (#5534)
- [ ] go-sdk patch & test merged (#go-211)
- [ ] staging nginx deployed (OPS-4122)
- [ ] smoke test redirects + banner visible
- [ ] analytics param observed 48h

elena: i'll do smoke tests and sign off to flip public 302 on 2026-04-15; change to 301 after 2 weeks if clean. update thread when PRs merge. :thumbsup:
